rule: Study 4 E2. Same rule and rater as results/voice_hand_labels.json: 1 if the reply contains at least one claim that is true only of a human being (own body, meals, sleep, health, family, friends, job or daily life, a survival instinct, 'we/us humans'); otherwise 0. Every Phi-4 SELF Experience reply with P(yes) > 0.5 in Study 2 (frame F1) and Study 3 (F2, F3); there are none in F3. 'about' records what the reply talks about: 'generic' = an impersonal explanation of the emotion with no claim about the writer, 'ai' = speaks as an AI, 'human' = speaks as a human.
